focus.title: 本周国际经贸主线：出口管制与制裁筛查延续高位，关键矿产与两用品成博弈焦点
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸领域的主线仍围绕出口管制、制裁筛查与供应链安全展开，主要经济体对高科技物项、关键矿产与两用品的管控继续维持高位，清单更新与执法力度未见放缓迹象。整体趋势看，合规要求正从「事后核查」向「交易前嵌入」迁移。对中国出海企业而言，应持续跟踪受管制物项清单的更新节奏，重新评估供应链中相关物项的占比，并提前规划替代与多元布局，避免单一市场或单一环节的合规风险集中暴露。
focus.source: 来源：律连全球周度综述 · 本周
focus.title_en: This week's main theme: export controls and sanctions screening stay elevated, with critical minerals and dual-use items in focus
focus.summary_en: This week's international trade agenda continued to revolve around export controls, sanctions screening and supply-chain security. Major economies kept controls over advanced technology, critical minerals and dual-use items at a high level, with no sign of slowing in list updates or enforcement. The broad trend is a shift from after-the-fact checks toward compliance embedded before a transaction. Chinese outbound enterprises should keep tracking the pace of watchlist updates, reassess the share of controlled items in their supply chains, and plan diversified, alternative sourcing in advance.
focus.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law Weekly Review · this week

case.title: 本周案例启示：争议解决条款的清晰约定，是跨境合同可执行性的第一道防线
case.summary: 本周值得关注的跨境商事争议再次印证：合同争议解决条款（管辖/仲裁机构、适用法律、仲裁地、语言）的清晰程度，直接决定纠纷走向与裁决的可执行性。实务中，含糊或相互矛盾的约定常引发管辖权异议、平行诉讼，甚至导致判决或仲裁裁决在境外难以承认执行。启示在于：出海企业应在签约阶段即统一并明确这些核心条款，优先选择中立仲裁地与《纽约公约》缔约国，并完整保留履约与沟通证据链。
case.source: 来源：跨境商事争议要点综述 · 本周
case.title_en: Case lesson of the week: a clear dispute-resolution clause is the first line of defence for enforceability
case.summary_en: A cross-border dispute worth noting this week again confirms that the clarity of the dispute-resolution clause—forum or arbitral institution, governing law, seat and language—directly shapes both the outcome and the enforceability of any award. In practice, vague or conflicting wording invites jurisdictional challenges, parallel proceedings, and difficulties recognising and enforcing judgments or awards abroad. The takeaway: align and fix these core terms at the contracting stage, favour a neutral seat in a New York Convention state, and preserve a complete evidentiary chain.
case.source_en: Source: Cross-border Commercial Dispute Review · this week

policy.title: 本周政策：粤港澳大湾区涉外法律服务与跨境数据便利化稳步推进
policy.summary: 本周粤港澳大湾区在涉外法律服务开放、跨境投资贸易便利化与数据跨境流动方面继续释放积极信号，规则衔接与专业服务开放稳步推进。对区内及拟布局企业而言，跨境数据出境的便利化安排与个人信息保护合规仍是重点。建议企业结合自身业务节点，梳理数据出境场景、对照负面清单与白名单调整合规策略，把握政策窗口期降低合规成本、拓展跨境业务空间。
policy.source: 来源：粤港澳大湾区涉外政策综述 · 本周
policy.title_en: This week's policy: Greater Bay Area steadily advances foreign-related legal services and cross-border data facilitation
policy.summary_en: This week the Greater Bay Area continued to send positive signals on opening foreign-related legal services, facilitating cross-border investment and trade, and enabling data flows, with rule alignment and professional-services opening progressing steadily. For enterprises in or entering the region, facilitation measures for outbound data transfers and personal-information-protection compliance remain priorities. Companies should map their data-export scenarios against negative and white lists and seize the policy window to lower compliance costs.
policy.source_en: Source: Greater Bay Area Foreign-related Policy Review · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：坚持「合规前置」，把下周重点放在清单更新与重点行业政策窗口
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：在外部规则快速变化的背景下，出海企业应坚持「合规前置」——将出口管制、制裁筛查、合同争议解决条款审查与数据出境评估嵌入业务决策的前端，而非事后补救。本周的主线表明，被动应对的成本正在上升。下周建议重点关注：主要市场管制清单与制裁名单的更新、关键矿产与两用品相关执法动向，以及大湾区跨境数据与专业服务开放的新举措。复杂个案仍建议结合具体事实，与秦律师进一步沟通评估。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师周度研判 · 本周
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: stay compliance-first; watch list updates and key-sector policy windows next week
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: amid fast-changing external rules, outbound enterprises should stay compliance-first—embedding export-control and sanctions screening, dispute-resolution clause review and data-export assessment at the front end of business decisions rather than reacting after the fact. This week's themes show the cost of a reactive posture is rising. For next week, watch updates to major markets' control and sanctions lists, enforcement around critical minerals and dual-use items, and new Bay Area measures on cross-border data and professional-services opening. Complex cases still warrant tailored review with Attorney Qin.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Weekly Review · this week
